cases.source: The brand's quarters are prose: one sentence carries the three-month figure, the prior-year figure and often the year-to-date figure as well. In the third-quarter filing the sentence with the figures does not name the brand and the sentence that names it carries no figure. The fourth quarter is the 10-K's year less those nine months.
